title: Birthday cake with candles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='24' cy='64' r='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='64' r='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='64' r='4' fill='#ffe66d'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#a8e6cf'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#a8e6cf'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#a8e6cf'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#a8e6cf'/>
